official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Connect your OneStation account to check your projects and recent creations, explore supported models and voices, and prepare image, video, music, speech or sound-effect creations. Every creation shows its parameters first and only runs after your explicit approval. Track each request and retrieve available results.

A OneStation account is required. Model access depends on your account and provider availability. Some platform features are not available through this plugin. Completion may require a status check in the conversation.

Provided by ROCKET TECNOLOGIA E INTERMEDIACAO LTDA. Support: astro@onestation.ai.
